function _push(IERC20 token, address to, uint256 amount) private { uint256 toBefore = token.balanceOf(to); uint256 poolBefore = token.balanceOf(address(this)); _call(address(token), abi.encodeCall(IERC20.transfer, (to, amount))); uint256 toAfter = token.balanceOf(to); uint256 poolAfter = token.balanceOf(address(this)); require( toAfter >= toBefore && toAfter - toBefore == amount && poolBefore >= poolAfter && poolBefore - poolAfter == amount, "unsupported token (fee on transfer)" ); }
